unresolved_or_blocking: No production Store-backed WorkerControlAuthority is configured; all /v1/worker/* routes return 503 by default.
No canonical TaskClaim signed-byte preimage, production issuer, signer/key custodian, audience registry, revocation/high-water or durable nonce authority exists.
No authenticated ExecutionFence reservation/completion receipt or restart-safe public receipt lookup exists; test projection is accepted by WS3 only with limits.
Current Store renewal/fence DTOs are internal unversioned structs and differ from the proposed LeaseRenewalV1 / ExecutionFenceV2 public shapes.
ACL digest, event digest and outcome digest preimages need producer-owned definitions and exact immutable negative/golden fixtures.
MCP local gateway deliberately exposes read-only tools only; no durable mutating idempotency adapter is configured, so mutating MCP calls are disabled.
No production activation, route alias, cross-part contract ratification, D-01 authority decision, D-02 writer-barrier decision or WS4 migration approval is implied by this registry.
